description: Get movies TMDB recommends for the given movie id, based on co-viewing/personalization data (what users who liked this also liked) — usually the more thematically relevant list. Prefer this over get_similar as the default choice; get_similar matches on shared genres/keywords, a blunter heuristic that can surface tonally unrelated titles. Get the id from search_movies.

page.description: 1-based page number for pagination (TMDB returns up to 20 results per page, max 500).

name: get_movie_recommendations

vote_average.description: TMDB's own 0-10 user score. A different audience and scale from the IMDb/RT/Metacritic scores get_movie/get_tv return as `ratings` — don't compare, average or substitute across the two.

title: Get movie recommendations
